5 تلكّأ عَلَيْهِ He excused himself to him; he pleaded an excuse to him. (K.) ―
-b2- تلكّأ عَنْهُ He was slow to do it; delayed to do it; (S, K, TA;) excused himself, or pleaded an excuse, for not doing it; refused to do it, or abstained from doing it. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
